Alembic migration script to add "order" and "content" columns to "source_contents" table.

# Purpose
This code is a database migration script using Alembic, a database migration tool for SQLAlchemy. It defines an [`upgrade`](<#upgrade>) function that modifies the `source_contents` table by adding two new columns: `order` (an integer) and `content` (a text field), and updates an index on the `content_type_id` column. The [`upgrade`](<#upgrade>) function also sets a server default value of 0 for the `order` column for future inserts. The [`downgrade`](<#downgrade>) function is intended to reverse these changes, although it contains a note indicating potential bugs. The script includes revision identifiers to track the migration's position in the sequence of database changes.
